verdict.rationale: PostHog's product analytics docs explicitly describe building funnels and drop-off/retention analysis directly on captured events, plus dashboards, alerts, and self-serve insights without needing an analyst or engineer involvement. This directly matches the founder story of self-serve activation-funnel analysis. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on case study specifically showing a founder using funnels to diagnose activation drop-off, and no UI screenshots demonstrating ease-of-use for non-analysts.
